description: Floor to ceiling pigeonholes, one tape to a hole, alphabetised and numbered. In front of each is a little card slot, and in each slot either a blank card, meaning the tape is in, or a card with a name and a date on it in blunt pencil, meaning it is out and when it is due back. About a third of the slots have names in them. Two have names with a line drawn under them, twice.
name: the tape wall
